title.en: It has been repaired; it is said that
title.de: Mehr Passiv: has been repaired, it is said
title.sl: Več trpnika: has been repaired, it is said
title.it: Ancora il passivo: has been repaired, it is said

goal.sl: Rabiš trpnik v vseh časih in z modalnimi glagoli (has been repaired, is being repaired, should have been shut) ter poveš, kar ljudje pravijo (It is said that, He is thought to be).
goal.de: Du nimmst das Passiv in allen Zeiten und mit Modalverben (has been repaired, is being repaired, should have been shut) und sagst, was man sagt (It is said that, He is thought to be).
goal.it: Usi il passivo in ogni tempo e con i modali (has been repaired, is being repaired, should have been shut) e dici quello che si dice (It is said that, He is thought to be).
goal.en: You can use the passive in every tense and with modals (has been repaired, is being repaired, should have been shut), and say what people say (It is said that, He is thought to be).

say.sl: Kar je že narejeno, pove **has been** ali **have been** + deležnik: **The roof has been mended.** (Streho so popravili.) **The letters have been sent.** Pomemben je rezultat zdaj, ne kdaj. V govoru **It's been mended.**, **They've been sent.** Ljudje rečejo tudi *It's been broke*; pisava hoče **broken**.
say.de: Was schon gemacht ist, sagt **has been** oder **have been** + Partizip: **The roof has been mended.** (Das Dach ist repariert worden.) **The letters have been sent.** Wichtig ist das Ergebnis jetzt, nicht wann. Gesprochen **It's been mended.**, **They've been sent.** Man sagt auch *It's been broke*; geschrieben steht **broken**.
say.it: Quello che è già fatto lo dice **has been** o **have been** + participio: **The roof has been mended.** (Il tetto è stato riparato.) **The letters have been sent.** Conta il risultato ora, non quando. A voce **It's been mended.**, **They've been sent.** Si dice anche *It's been broke*; per iscritto si usa **broken**.
say.en: What is already done takes **has been** or **have been** + the participle: **The roof has been mended.** **The letters have been sent.** The result now matters, not when. In talk **It's been mended.**, **They've been sent.** People also say *It's been broke*; writing wants **broken**.

say.sl: Kar se dela prav zdaj, pove **is being** ali **are being** + deležnik: **The road is being repaired.** (Cesto popravljajo.) **The sheep are being sheared.** Za preteklost **was being**: **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** (Most so popravljali, ko je prišla poplava.) Slovenščina reče *popravljajo*.
say.de: Was gerade geschieht, sagt **is being** oder **are being** + Partizip: **The road is being repaired.** (Die Straße wird gerade repariert.) **The sheep are being sheared.** Für die Vergangenheit **was being**: **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** (Die Brücke wurde gerade repariert, als die Flut kam.) *Wird gerade* ist also **is being**.
say.it: Quello che si sta facendo lo dice **is being** o **are being** + participio: **The road is being repaired.** (Stanno riparando la strada.) **The sheep are being sheared.** Per il passato **was being**: **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.** (Stavano riparando il ponte quando è arrivata la piena.) L'italiano dice *stanno riparando*.
say.en: What is going on right now takes **is being** or **are being** + the participle: **The road is being repaired.** **The sheep are being sheared.** For the past **was being**: **The bridge was being mended when the flood came.**

say.sl: Tudi drugi časi: spremeni se le be, deležnik ostane: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** (Seno je bilo pokošeno, preden je prišel dež.) **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** Tudi z modalnimi: **It should be mended soon.** **It might be closed.** **It has to be done today.**
say.de: Auch die anderen Zeiten: Nur be ändert sich, das Partizip bleibt: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** (Das Heu war gemäht worden, bevor der Regen kam.) **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** Auch mit Modalverben: **It should be mended soon.** **It might be closed.** **It has to be done today.**
say.it: Anche gli altri tempi: cambia solo be, il participio resta: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** (Il fieno era stato tagliato prima che arrivasse la pioggia.) **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** Anche con i modali: **It should be mended soon.** **It might be closed.** **It has to be done today.**
say.en: The other tenses too: only be changes, the participle stays: **The hay had been cut before the rain came.** **It will be finished by Friday.** **It's going to be sold.** With modals too: **It should be mended soon.** **It might be closed.** **It has to be done today.**

say.sl: S **should have**, **must have**, **can't have** gre **been** + deležnik: **The gate should have been shut.** (Vrata bi morala biti zaprta.) **My hat must have been taken.** (Klobuk mi je moral nekdo vzeti.) **The van can't have been mended yet.** (Kombi še ne more biti popravljen.)
say.de: Nach **should have**, **must have**, **can't have** kommt **been** + Partizip: **The gate should have been shut.** (Das Tor hätte geschlossen werden sollen.) **My hat must have been taken.** (Mein Hut muss genommen worden sein.) **The van can't have been mended yet.** (Der Lieferwagen kann noch nicht repariert worden sein.)
say.it: Dopo **should have**, **must have**, **can't have** viene **been** + participio: **The gate should have been shut.** (Il cancello doveva essere chiuso.) **My hat must have been taken.** (Il mio cappello dev'essere stato preso.) **The van can't have been mended yet.** (Il furgone non può essere già stato riparato.)
say.en: After **should have**, **must have**, **can't have** comes **been** + the participle: **The gate should have been shut.** **My hat must have been taken.** **The van can't have been mended yet.**

say.sl: Kar ljudje pravijo, se v pisavi začne z **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** (Pravijo, da jezerce nima dna.) Slovenščina reče *pravijo, da*, in brez it ne gre. V govoru: **People say that**. V preteklosti: **It was thought that**.
say.de: Was man sagt, beginnt geschrieben mit **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** (Man sagt, dass der Bergsee keinen Grund hat.) Deutsch hat dafür *man sagt*; it muss stehen. Gesprochen **People say that**. In der Vergangenheit **It was thought that**.
say.it: Quello che si dice comincia, per iscritto, con **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** (Si dice che il laghetto non abbia fondo.) L'italiano dice *si dice che*; it deve esserci, e dopo non c'è congiuntivo. A voce **People say that**. Al passato **It was thought that**.
say.en: What people say begins, in writing, with **It is said that**, **It is thought that**, **It is believed that**, **It is known that**: **It is said that the tarn has no bottom.** In talk **People say that**. In the past **It was thought that**.

say.sl: Osebek lahko gre naprej, potem **to be**: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** (Pravijo, da je Stari Wilf star devetdeset let.) **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Za preteklost **to have** + deležnik: **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** (Pravijo, da so most zgradili Rimljani.)
say.de: Das Subjekt kann nach vorn, dann **to be**: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** (Der alte Wilf soll neunzig sein.) **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Für die Vergangenheit **to have** + Partizip: **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** (Die Brücke soll von den Römern gebaut worden sein.)
say.it: Il soggetto può andare davanti, poi **to be**: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** (Si dice che il vecchio Wilf abbia novant'anni.) **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** Per il passato **to have** + participio: **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.** (Si dice che il ponte sia stato costruito dai Romani.)
say.en: The subject can go first, then **to be**: **Old Wilf is said to be ninety.** **Wastwater is known to be very deep.** For the past **to have** + the participle: **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** **The bridge is said to have been built by the Romans.**

exercises.text: The bridge on the Keswick road is closed. It ___ at the moment. It ___ in last year's storm. Since then nothing ___, but now new stones ___ from Kendal. The work ___ by Friday, and a notice ___ on the gate.

translation.sl: Most na cesti v Keswick je zaprt. Prav zdaj ga popravljajo. Poškodovan je bil v lanski nevihti. Od takrat niso naredili ničesar, zdaj pa so iz Kendala pripeljali nove kamne. Delo bo končano do petka, na vratih pa je obvestilo.
translation.de: Die Brücke an der Straße nach Keswick ist gesperrt. Sie wird gerade repariert. Sie wurde im Sturm letztes Jahr beschädigt. Seither ist nichts gemacht worden, aber jetzt sind neue Steine aus Kendal gebracht worden. Die Arbeit wird bis Freitag fertig sein, und beim Tor ist ein Schild aufgestellt worden.
translation.it: Il ponte sulla strada per Keswick è chiuso. Lo stanno riparando. È stato danneggiato nel temporale dell'anno scorso. Da allora non è stato fatto niente, ma ora sono state portate nuove pietre da Kendal. Il lavoro sarà finito entro venerdì, e sul cancello è stato messo un avviso.
translation.en: The bridge on the Keswick road is closed. It is being mended at the moment. It was damaged in last year's storm. Since then nothing has been done, but now new stones have been brought from Kendal. The work will be finished by Friday, and a notice has been put up on the gate.

exercises.text: Long Meg and her daughters, near Penrith, ___ said to be witches turned to stone. It ___ said that nobody can count them twice and get the same number. The stones ___ (think) to be very old.

translation.sl: Long Meg in njene hčere pri Penrithu naj bi bile čarovnice, spremenjene v kamen. Pravijo, da jih nihče ne more prešteti dvakrat in dobiti isto število. Mislijo, da so kamni zelo stari.
translation.de: Long Meg und ihre Töchter bei Penrith sollen Hexen sein, die zu Stein geworden sind. Man sagt, niemand könne sie zweimal zählen und auf dieselbe Zahl kommen. Man glaubt, dass die Steine sehr alt sind.
translation.it: Si dice che Long Meg e le sue figlie, vicino a Penrith, siano streghe trasformate in pietra. Si dice che nessuno riesca a contarle due volte ottenendo lo stesso numero. Si pensa che le pietre siano molto antiche.
translation.en: Long Meg and her daughters, near Penrith, are said to be witches turned to stone. It is said that nobody can count them twice and get the same number. The stones are thought to be very old.

exercises.text: The Packhorse is closed this week. The roof ___ (mend) at the moment. The kitchen ___ (paint) already. It ___ (open) again on Friday. It should ___ (finish) last week.

translation.de: Das Packhorse ist diese Woche geschlossen. Das Dach wird gerade repariert. Die Küche ist schon gestrichen worden. Am Freitag wird es wieder geöffnet. Es hätte letzte Woche fertig werden sollen.
translation.it: Il Packhorse è chiuso questa settimana. Stanno riparando il tetto. La cucina è già stata dipinta. Riaprirà venerdì. Doveva essere finito la settimana scorsa.
translation.en: The Packhorse is closed this week. The roof is being mended at the moment. The kitchen has been painted already. It will be opened again on Friday. It should have been finished last week.
